title: Concept: Serialised data breaking out of a script block
description: An inline script whose serialised value contains a closing script tag in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The parser ends the script at the first closing tag, so data that contains one turns the remainder into markup, which is a stored script injection through a value the page believed was JSON.
applicability: Deployments that render an inline script whose serialised value contains a closing script tag into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The parser ends the script at the first closing tag, so data that contains one turns the remainder into markup, which is a stored script injection through a value the page believed was JSON.
